upload_description_plain:
While working on this i always found something was missing, Bernard L'ermite helped me out with his boy choir sample. The main womens-choir is a free sample i took from samplefocus. (https://samplefocus.com/samples/time-of-war-female-choir?search_id=200166860).

The track is a wild blend of guitar, wobbles, choir,  hardstyle synths and more, bouncing in your ears.

The title speaks for itself. War is terrible, but peace is a lot of times seen as something dull. Well, peace can be energetic and fully dynamic as well. Dance off the bad vibes and get into the rythm!

Enjoy! Frank

ps. I have included the stems for the people who like it....The only ones missing are the dominator like sample, but you can find heaps of free samples like that online and the whip sample, they must be somewhere on my computer but i have not been able to locate them yet.

the guitar is done with Hellraiser VST and the Bagpipe is done with a VST called Highland Pipes

I missed Admiral Bob's original call for RUN DMC type rapping, hope I've answered the call well enough some... 17 years later.

Family safe rhymes in the tradition of one of the RUN DMC founders.

PRODUCTION TIP FROM CYMATICS.FM
They have a plug in called Diablo there's a
FREE version and a
PAID version.

This is a drum plug in, though this works with any "make it thumpy" drum plug in.

Run your bass through it.

The focus of this song was not Admiral Bob's top line, actually I heavily relegated it to a third place of importance.

Instead I made the bass the focus, made it thumpy, raw, and turned it up quite loud.

Bob's organ playing? I can't hear the organ in the original mixed sample, you can hear it quite well here. Still subdued but present.

Not only is the whole sample slowed down to 95 BPM, but when I'm rapping the main bars (not talking or the bridge) the guitar top line slows down even more. Not the bass, not the organ, just the guitars. Check the instrumental and you'll hear it.

Drum Beat from the producer "Bizkel" you'll find him on The Drum Broker and other sites.
And a drum roll from Daniel Blonde, who also has his own site but you'll find him on The Drum Broker and other sites.

Scratched up public domain samples from Gowler Music.

Thank you Ivan Chew! 

What a treat to be with Ivan's music.  He is a generous ccMixter contributor with a vast library.  I wish I had more time and better chops to play with his offerings. I am grateful he had this amazing instrumental track to sing along to. I struggled with the writing and only finished the lyrics the morning of upload day which left me little time to record, clean up, and mix the track.  Thus, I offer this heartfelt but incomplete track as a work in progress.

The lyrics are inspired by consultation with the Tarot and IChing, including The Tower card, hexagram 29 (The Abyss), hexagram 20 (Viewing/Contemplating), hexagram 44 (Coming to Meet).

IT'S DEEP


It's deep 
Can't see
It's dark 
still we breathe
We brace We freeze
We don't know what we need
What's next unseen
Rumble of fracturing
It's deep beliefs
so dark still we breathe

(The stars at night are like fairy dust)
Same stars same sky
Same dark same light
(The stars at night are like fairy dust)
Guiding time

(The stars at night are like fairy dust)
Same stars same sky Guiding time

We saw the tower fall before the lightning strike
Fires foretold through visionary eyes 
Here is shock but really no surprise
We know what's true we see  the lies

Here is shock but really no surprise
The stars are guiding time
I'll hold your heart. Can you hold mine?
Our beating hearts are the light

Come with me to  meet
what's Shown to  us in  our dreams
What we sense we need to see
What is there among the grief
Tears flow to the deep
Be here with me
still we breathe

upload_description_plain:
This is a remix of "This Beat" by Donnie Ozone, done with Suno AI.

There are TWO copies of the instrumentals for the song, and there's a reason for that. The BPM of the samples is exactly 92, not 93 which is the mixed song.

AI sounds have a "flutter" when you stem separate them. But Suno now has a "remaster" and a "get stems" feature to split off vocals and instrumentals. I'll go into that more in a tutorial, but long story short:

Using the remaster feature, you make two copies of the same song, which have the exact same BPM, timing and everything... except they're not waveform copies. So when you layer two copies of each track (bass, drums, musical, vocals) you get a doublet sound and the "flutter" is greatly reduced. It also sounds more like a live band.

Bonus: Sometimes you get small ad libs that will only appear in one copy. It greatly helps the "live band" effect.

If you are going to sample these sounds, use both copies of the sound to export your sample.
upload_description_html:
This is a remix of “This Beat” by Donnie Ozone, done with Suno AI.

There are TWO copies of the instrumentals for the song, and there’s a reason for that. The BPM of the samples is exactly 92, not 93 which is the mixed song.

AI sounds have a “flutter” when you stem separate them. But Suno now has a “remaster” and a “get stems” feature to split off vocals and instrumentals. I’ll go into that more in a tutorial, but long story short:

Using the remaster feature, you make two copies of the same song, which have the exact same BPM, timing and everything… except they’re not waveform copies. So when you layer two copies of each track (bass, drums, musical, vocals) you get a doublet sound and the “flutter” is greatly reduced. It also sounds more like a live band.

Bonus: Sometimes you get small ad libs that will only appear in one copy. It greatly helps the “live band” effect.

If you are going to sample these sounds, use both copies of the sound to export your sample.

upload_description_plain:
It's November 22nd, 2001. You're an average citizen of Kandahar, Afghanistan. The fighting is many kilometers away. It will be days if not weeks before this "coalition of the willing" gets to Kandahar.

It's 3:33 PM. The sun dims, and the civil sirens begin to wail for you to take cover...

-----

All sounds are in the key of D.

This is a soundtrack for this comic book: https://tangentsbrand.com/wyrd-and-akward/

Mr McCosar's rides came in handy. Surprisingly not a lot of those under the "by" tag by themselves. Maybe hiding in kits.

Anyway, I've split a good number of the loops but not all of them. Some of them didn't improve. However doing so truly improved this mix.

Samples coming shortly after the song uploads...
